title: Remove Parent Field From Type And Design Structs
description: Remove the Parent field from Type and Design structs (and their Meta/Shallow/Diff variants) in semio/go/main.go. Keep Folder's Parent field. Update all related code: constructors, merkle hash, diff functions, equality checks, applyDiff, inverseDiff, guid remapping, guid collection, SQLite read/write, and getConnector parent chain walking.
summary:
Removed the `Parent` field from Type and Design structs (and their Meta/Shallow/Diff variants) in `semio/go/main.go`. Folder's Parent field was kept intact. Changes made:

1. Removed `Parent` field from 8 structs: Type, TypeDiff, TypeMeta, TypeShallow, Design, DesignDiff, DesignMeta, DesignShallow
2. Removed `Parent: t.Parent` / `Parent: d.Parent` from ToTypeMeta, ToTypeShallow, ToDesignMeta, ToDesignShallow constructors
3. Removed `diff.Parent == nil &&` from isTypeDiffEmpty and isDesignDiffEmpty
4. Removed Type/Design parent guid remapping in RemapGuid (kept Folder's)
5. Simplified TypeNameUniquenessConstraint and DesignNameUniquenessConstraint to flat grouping (no parent-based sibling grouping)
6. Removed design parent validation from validateDesignDiffNestedGo
7. Simplified FilterDesignsWithoutParent to return all designs
8. Removed parent_guid from SQLite type/design read queries and scan
9. Removed parent_guid from SQLite type/design write queries
10. Updated TypeDiff docstring to remove "parent" mention

Verified: `go build ./...` succeeds with no errors. Many items from the user's list (hash functions, equality checks, applyDiff, inverseDiff, getConnector) were already clean and didn't reference Type/Design Parent.
